extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Echo transcribes your meetings from the microphone.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Echo uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to transcribe meetings.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Echo records system audio (calls, videos) so it can be transcribed together with your microphone.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Echo captures system audio through ScreenCaptureKit on macOS versions without system-audio-only capture.
